text: The major closely follows the development trend of the disciplines, characterized with network control, training students to have basic knowledge and technology in control theory and control engineering, computer science and technology, communication engineering, electrical engineering, and other fields of engineering. Graduates are qualified for such positions as movement control, industrial process control, communications and information transmission network control, detection and automated instrumentation, power electronics technology, computer application technology, in scientific research institutes, manufacturing, operating maintenance, and other departments involved. Advantages and features: Featured with intelligent, network-based, information technology, the major has 3 specialties: network control, automotive electronics and process control with distinct characteristics and good social reputation.
